question: What claim about the scope of the field group is at stake in relating it to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: The field group belongs to all earth-moving yoginīs.
The field group belongs to all sky-moving yoginīs.
It is described as a group of all fields.
inference: The field group is presented as encompassing all fields for all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The internal division of that field group is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
